quarterly_data.quarter: Baker Hughes press release: Baker Hughes and Venture Global Expand Strategic Long-Term (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Venture Global: Baker Hughes announced a new Power Frame Agreement with Venture Global and GE Vernova to support the development of behind-the-meter power generation in the United States. It establishes the framework for the supply of gas turbines, steam turbines and associated equipment and services for up to 16 new power island units; Baker Hughes will also provide the controls and electrical integration technology required to operate each island, including the E-house and electrical control systems. The framework is designed to support Venture Global's continued LNG production and liquefaction as well as potential future LNG-adjacent data center development projects, and builds on the LNG power island architecture Baker Hughes previously deployed for Venture Global facilities. Deliveries contemplated under the agreement are scheduled from 2028 through 2034; Venture Global currently expects to place the first power island purchase order by the end of 2026, with additional orders anticipated beginning in 2027. CEO Lorenzo Simonelli: 'Behind-the-meter power generation has emerged as a critical component to LNG operations as well as advancing the AI economy.'
quarterly_data.figure: up to 16 power island units; deliveries scheduled from 2028 through 2034; first purchase order expected by the end of 2026
